carwinch.coupling.tooltip: Right-click two tow bars on different SubLevels. Shift + right-click with a wrench to remove it.
carwinch.coupling.selected: Tow bar selected - choose the second tow bar
carwinch.coupling.occupied: This tow bar is already coupled
carwinch.coupling.failed: Could not create coupling: different SubLevels and distance up to 4 blocks are required
carwinch.rope.tooltip: Right click a winch, then a tow bar. Sneak + right click to cancel.
carwinch.rope.selected: Anchor selected - now click a tow bar
carwinch.rope.occupied: That anchor already has a rope
carwinch.rope.failed: Could not hitch the rope - too far, or not a winch + tow bar pair
